title: How UCC1-308 Can Set You Free (and why they don’t want you to know)
summary: Promoter teaches signing everything 'without prejudice UCC 1-308' with a 'human name', claiming it reserves all rights, keeps courts from binding you, and separates you from your all-caps corporation.

assertions.quote: it gives you a clear uh Authority showing you have not given up any of your rights
the all caps name is actually a public corporation it essentially is what is used to pull you into the corporate jurisdiction
a birth certificate uh which is actually a bond which creates a corporate entity in your all caps name
there are various jurisdictions that do not have jurisdiction over you unless you grant them that jurisdiction
when you hire a lawyer an attorney to represent you uh you are automatically giving the court jurisdiction over you

verdicts.note: Jurisdiction does not depend on representation; self-represented defendants are equally subject to the court.

The court cites precedent that federal courts have subject-matter and personal jurisdiction over defendants brought before them on federal indictments; jurisdiction comes from the indictment and law, not from hiring counsel.

assertions.quote: when you put brackets around any sentence ... it is essentially removing that section what you've put brackets around from the contract

verdicts.note: Unilateral marks do not alter a contract unless the other party agrees; style manuals have no legal effect.

assertions.quote: you are a person a person is a corporation we just read the definition

verdicts.note: The definition explicitly includes individuals alongside corporations; it does not make an individual a corporation.
The tax code's 'person' expressly includes an individual alongside corporations, so being a 'person' does not make one a corporation; courts reject the not-a-person argument.
